newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early edge.

text.p: Tight liquidity in the local currency market helped the Bangladesh taka retain the early edge to close stronger at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday, dealers said.
This compared with a previous close at 43.7600/7700.
Dealers said a low turnout of importers due to the weekend closure of major international markets also lifted the local unit.

Call money was traded at 11 to 12 percent against the previous 7.5-9.0 percent. Dealers said call rates shot up following payments against the purchases of central bank bills worth more than 1.5 billion taka. The bills were auctioned on Wednesday. - Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
